events.text: Oil change takes an average of 15 minutes to be completed at the shop
At 10 AM, a 3rd customer wants to wait for an oil change
Customer asks what to tell them if the shop can work on two vehicles at a time
Fourth customer is added to the scenario after establishing two vehicles can be worked on at a time
3rd and 4th customers add themselves to the queue; question about what to tell the 5th customer
